ios.desc:
Copying text into another AI app, waiting for a response, copying it back. There has to be a better way.

ChatWrite brings AI writing directly into your keyboard. It catches spelling mistakes, cleans up your grammar, and helps you say exactly what you mean, whether you're firing off a quick reply or writing a proper email. No switching apps. No copying anything across.

Respond to clients in seconds
Copy any incoming message and your agent writes a response for you instantly. Based on the instructions you gave it, in your voice.

Agents that already know your business
Create agents for any project, client, or role. Tell them once who you are, how you work, and how you like to communicate. You can even give them access to your calendar, so they always know what's coming up and can write around your schedule. No re-explaining your context every time, no starting from scratch, just quick replies that actually sound like you.

Translate anything, instantly
Reading a message in another language? Copy it and ChatWrite translates it on the spot — no switching apps, no copying across. Reply in your language, or theirs.

Works in every app you already use
Writing an email, replying in your favorite messaging app, drafting a social post. ChatWrite is the AI keyboard that lives wherever you type. Just open your keyboard and start writing.

Your privacy is protected
ChatWrite never logs or tracks your keystrokes. The AI only activates when you choose to use it. You stay in control.

Built for people whose business runs on their phone.
Used by real estate agents, recruiters, sales professionals, coaches, and anyone else whose day is spent communicating.
